issues.on_page: General Fund program lines print 7,716,131 (sum of printed lines ties); statement General column (p5) instruction + support = 7,537,771
issues.issue: Contra line (and matching other financing line detail[51]) is not printed; it is inferred because the 178,360 gap equals the transfers to Employee Benefit 28,360 (p9) and Depreciation 150,000 (p10). The arithmetic holds and it follows the hidden-transfer rule (computed, split_from, review set), but which program lines hold the transfers is an assumption; category 'support services' on the contra is arbitrary.

Statement of Activities (p2) counts all non-tuition local receipts (3,395,254 - 16,571 = 3,378,683) as 'Taxes collected', so this 2,156 is treated as a tax by the report; 'other taxes' could fit better than 'other' (same for detail[80]).
